-101.88800,33.57470.name: Fertility Specialists of Texas-Lubbock
-101.88800,33.57470.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Jerald Goldstein, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-87.68461,42.04700.name: Endeavor Health Clinical Operations
-87.68461,42.04700.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

Rats, mice and birds bred for research are excluded from the Act's definition of an animal — the overwhelming majority of animals used, and the great majority of the genetically altered ones.
